task_contract.name: permuted_keyed_memory_with_registry
task_contract.slot_permutation: Every frame independently places stable identities and readout in random slots; padding identity is -1.
task_contract.targets: Single-link routes 0.60 times the queried value. Two-link adds 0.35 times the cyclic successor value.
task_contract.data_separation: Fresh training, validation, test, and rollout seeds not used by v5-v7. Validation selects the action threshold. The sealed test split is evaluated once after strategy and threshold selection.

training_budget.batch_implementation: per_sample_gradient_accumulation; ModelNeuronGraph currently processes one graph per forward

decision_rules.quality_ci: Paired per-seed relative MSE delta; 95% two-sided t interval upper bound must be below zero.
decision_rules.interpretation: Fixed before the new test set is evaluated. Validation may select only the action confidence threshold.

limitations: Synthetic key-value retrieval/composition does not establish language or broad capability claims.
The neuron model has one shared parameter set across all graph positions; independent state is not a per-neuron weight set.
Pool sizes cover 4 to 64 memory neurons and do not establish asymptotic scaling.
Identity persistence is a local atomic JSON contract; concurrent writers and remote stores are outside this test.
Host and MPS memory are sampled and may miss transient peaks.
Total MPS FLOPs are not exactly countable in this PyTorch build; Linear MAC and multiply-add subtotals are reported separately.
A batch is represented as gradient accumulation across independent one-graph forwards; it is not graph-batched/vectorized.
The evaluation oracle is an upper-bound control derived from labels and is not an inference adapter or deployable model.
